content: My headphones gave me an electric shock while I was using them. This is dangerous—I need help with this immediately.

I’m sorry this happened—an electric shock is a serious safety issue.

- **Stop using the headphones. Don’t charge or test them again.** If they’re connected to mains power, switch off the power only if you can do so safely.
- If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, burns, faintness, or ongoing symptoms, **seek emergency medical help now**. Consider medical advice even if you feel okay.

This requires escalation to a human support agent. Please provide your **Cartly user ID and registered email or phone number**, plus the **order ID if available**, so I can verify your account, check the details, and arrange the handoff.
I'm not sure; I'd need to check.

That’s okay—don’t delay medical care to look up account details. Keep the headphones disconnected and don’t use or charge them.

I’ll pass your safety report to human support now with the information available. Account-specific help will still require verification. **Are you somewhere safe, and are you experiencing any symptoms or injuries?**
